Just received the clips this morning.  Easy installation and brewed my first cup of coffee.  When I pulled up the top to remove the k-cup the clip fell out.  The heat of one cup of coffee had softened the plastic enough that it wouldn't go back on.  Very disappointing product.  Seemed like a great idea but they need to be able to withstand the heat better.  I don't even have the coffee set to brew on the hottest setting.

This clip does work in fooling the Keurig 2.0 machines into thinking that every attempt to brew is a 2.0 compatible K-Cup. However, if you have a more advanced model like my K-550, it assumes that a Keurig K-Cup is always installed in the unit. That presents several problems in that is it always ready to Brew...Ignores the time clock settings and overrides your chance to simply get hot water from your Keurig system.
If all you want to do is brew standard K-Cup coffee it works great ! If you want the option to brew K-Carafes or simply to get hot water for your Ramen Noodles, or to check the time, it does not work very well\

This same company sells Keurig 2.0 compatible stickers which you attach to the K-cup to make them 2.0 compatible and the system will automatically revert back to it's normal configuration when you remove the K-Cup with the override sticker.

You will need ot evaluate which works best for you.

By the way....I only received 5 Clever Clips instead of the 6X displayed in the Amazon order.

Like everyone else - I found these work for a maximum of two to three days, then they get bent out of shape from the heat and fall out.  These need to be made of a more durable material.
But heat warps it too quickly (5-10 cups) at which point it becomes unusable unless manually inserted for each use.

So I bought these because they were cheap, yes, BUT, I already had one of these exact clips that came free with a box of coffee I ordered. The free clip was fantastic. Seeing as how I only use my Keurig 2-3 times a day on the weekends and once on weekdays, it the original lasted several months. THESE clips however do not.

They arrived quickly, which was good because my old clip had finally died. One of the clips was completely broke upon arrival. I put one on and it snapped in pretty tightly, so I figured all good. But, when I opened it to make another coffee, it immediately fell off and the plastic already looked like it was going to snap off at the bend. Repeatedly I had to put it back in before use. So I figured, it's just this one and I'll try another. Put it in, go to change it after one use, same thing. Fell out and ready to break.

I am going to finish off this bag, which may be by the end of the week unfortunately, and will not purchase this type again.
